_comment: The art lives here. Edit freely, no code changes needed. Subjects are BARE noun phrases with no article: the template adds 'a'/'an'. One instrument per stem, so a monument says what it is the moment you see it; the variants within a role are all the same instrument, only presented differently. What the music decides is the rest of the line: material from brightness, size from density, condition from noisiness.
